name: Stray
tested: playable on iPad, early testing (1.5, Steam).
why: cap texture streaming memory to the device's RAM: the Mac build sizes it for a GPU with its own memory; turn off capsule shadows, whose tiled pass blacks out the fog in every 16-pixel tile the cat touches on iOS (hard-edged black blocks around the cat on the title screen); render at 75% and let MetalFX's temporal upscaler fill in the rest: about 58 frames/s on the title screen of an M1 iPad Pro instead of 45, with no visible difference (50% reaches the 60 frames/s cap but only gains 2 more)
